summary: Checked positions 152-298 (147 buildings): Haiku had 10 keep, 6 unsure, 131 skip. Result: 9 keeps accepted (keep_ok), 5 of them ordinary types (palacio-diaz, edificio-ariztia, edificio-do-banco-paulista-do-comercio, edificio-guardiola, coliseo-la-tortuga; weakest are guardiola and coliseo); 1 keep dropped for no usable main photo (botter-appartement); 2 keeps need a better main photo (galeria-guemes, coliseo-la-tortuga); 9 field fixes (by, concepts, year x4, features); 0 keep_wrong; 2 rescued (selim-al-deen-muktamanch, faculty-of-fine-arts-university-of-dhaka). Still unsure, no usable exterior main photo: Africa Hall (only interiors and people), Restaurante Zambi (chimney only), Manik Bagh (portraits only), Centro SCOP (street view of a complex, and the lead says it was a complex), Luis David Cruz Ocampo library (entrance doors only). Chandigarh College of Architecture has only a logo. Skips confirmed as right in all other cases; borderline skips for the owner: Ohel Yizkor (Yad Vashem, Sharon et al.; good exterior photo but lead gives only the ceremony use), and several strong buildings with empty leads (House of Victoria Ocampo, Senate Palace Tehran, The Glass Building Tehran, Ab-o-Atash Amphitheatre, Igreja Matriz Presidente Getulio) which stay skipped under the empty-lead rule.
